business_problem: Haidian's rapid urban growth made manual, department-siloed governance too slow and expensive, especially for problems like muck-truck regulation where data fragmentation and cross-department coordination prevented efficient response.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud and Haidian District built a city-brain operating model that combines AI recognition, spatiotemporal data, and cross-department data fusion to automate urban-governance scenarios. In the featured muck-truck use case, the city brain unifies construction-site records, satellite map layers, nearby video feeds, disposal-site data, and departmental datasets from traffic, environmental, and urban-management systems into a single one-vehicle-one-file view. The project follows a 'three integrations and five cross-domain links' design that merges technology, business, and data while reaching across levels, towns, systems, departments, and business functions. Baidu's data service center acts as the core data hub, using deep learning, knowledge graphs, and multimodal data understanding to capture violations, predict routes, support law-enforcement evidence, and automate case handling. The same model then extends to other city operations such as snow and ice response, where camera-based AI can warn municipal teams tens of minutes earlier than traditional monitoring alone.

solution_components.name: Haidian City Brain
solution_components.role: Coordinates cross-domain urban-governance data, AI recognition, prediction, and enforcement workflows across Haidian's smart-city scenarios.

solution_components.name: Data Service Center
solution_components.role: Acts as the core urban data hub, processing heterogeneous image, voice, spatial, and operational data for governance analytics and action.

data_flow: Construction-site data, satellite imagery, road video, disposal-site information, and cross-department datasets are fused inside the city brain, AI models identify vehicles and violations, prediction models estimate routes and risk, and the outputs flow into enforcement, dispatch, and other city-governance actions.
business_outcome: Haidian improved urban-governance precision and enforcement efficiency, sharply reduced muck-truck violations, and created a reusable smart-city operating model for other safety and service scenarios.

evidence_quotes: Haidian uses Baidu AI Cloud's artificial-intelligence technology in the city brain to fuse needs, business, data, and technology and keep evolving smart-city governance. (original: 利用百度智能云人工智能技术，在海淀城市大脑实现全面的创新应用，形成需求、业务、数据、技术的融合发展和动态演进。)

The solution integrates construction-site data, satellite map layers, nearby video, disposal-site data, and city-level department data into a full-chain one-vehicle-one-file system. (original: 系统整合了工地信息、卫星图斑、周边视频、消纳地点等监测数据，以及交通、环保、城管等市级和区级跨部门数据，将渣土车全链条的数据进行打通、融合，构建一车一档信息。)

The system increased muck-truck captures by nearly 30%, pushed violation-feature recognition accuracy above 95%, route prediction above 60%, and reduced the violation rate from 26% to 4%. (original: 可以实现渣土车抓拍数量提升近30%，系统对渣土车号牌遮挡等违法特征识别的准确率达到95%以上，渣土车行驶轨迹预测分析准确率超过60%，渣土车违规率从26%下降到了4%。)

The city brain is built on a core data service center that turns image, voice, and spatial data into an urban data brain for intelligent city operation. (original: “数据服务中心”作为百度城市大脑的核心组成部分...通过人工智能、大数据、知识图谱等技术手段，对城市影像、语音、空间等多源异构数据进行智能化识别、理解、处理和分析，形成“城市数据大脑”。)

The platform processes more than 60 million data records a day, about 160,000 items daily, 21T of algorithm data per day, nearly 200 sub-algorithms, and 20+ smart scenarios. (original: 摄像头上万路，传感器2万点位作用，每天获取的数据大概有6000多万条，日均需要处理数据16万条左右；感知算法数据达到每天21T，涉及近200个子算法、20万次调用、20多个智慧化场景。)
